column2: Your Level, then your Fame to break a tie between two games.
Three Banners
Conquer 3 fortified sites: Keeps or Mage Towers.
Three assaults to prepare: find Siege, Units, and absorb the loss of Reputation.
8 Countryside tiles: keep in priority those with a Keep or Mage Tower.
As soon as the third site is conquered, play one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the fourth Round.
Solved if your Shields mark 3 fortified sites. Note the number of Rounds used.
The Siege
Conquer the City.
A single City, and four Rounds to build the army that will bring it down. Adjustable difficulty.
City level: 3 for an accessible game, 5 for a hard game, 8 for experts.
When the City is conquered, play one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the fourth Round.
The Depths
Conquer 3 adventure sites, at least one of them a Dungeon or a Tomb.
Underground, your Units stay outside and Night rules apply. A scenario for a self-reliant Hero.
8 Countryside tiles: keep in priority those with a Dungeon, Monster Den or Ruins.
An activated Ruins Altar counts as a conquered site.
Solved if your Shields mark the 3 required sites.
Against the clock
Conquer a level 3 City in three Rounds.
Day, Night, Day. No time to dawdle: every turn must bring you closer to the City.
1 Core tile with a City, placed last in the deck.
The City is level 3.
When the City is conquered, or at the end of the third Round.
Draconum Slayer
Defeat 2 rampaging Draconum.
Red enemies are the most dangerous in the game. You'll need to grow stronger before going after them.
3 Core tiles without a City: keep in priority those with Draconum.
Only rampaging Draconum placed on the board count, not red enemies from a Tomb or Ruins.
As soon as the second Draconum is defeated, play one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the fourth Round.
Solved if both Draconum are defeated. Each earns +2 Reputation.
Blitz Cooperative Conquest
Conquer both Cities together.
The rulebook's short cooperative scenario, faster and less difficult than Full Cooperation.
You must conquer both Cities: there are as many as players. The second one revealed, level 8, is deliberately too strong for a single Hero: it is taken by cooperative assault.
Cooperative assault: from a space adjacent to the City, a player proposes a split of the defenders; if the other accepts, each fights their share on their turn, then skips their next turn.
When all Cities are conquered, each player plays one last turn, not the Dummy.
Full Cooperation
4 h and more
Conquer all three Cities together.
The rulebook's full cooperative challenge: three Cities in six Rounds.
3 Core tiles with a City and 2 without.
The Cities are level 5, except the last one revealed, level 8.
Reconnaissance for two
Reveal the City, with each player having reached Level 3.
First Reconnaissance played hand in hand, to teach someone the game.
+1 Fame to the player who reveals a tile, whatever it is: only the explorer scores the point. Alternate explorations to progress together.
No Elite Units. You don't enter the City or conquer it. Only reveal Spells and Advanced Actions when they become useful.
When the City tile is revealed, each player plays one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the third Round.
Solved if the City is revealed and both Heroes are at least Level 3.
The Mines, together
Reveal all tiles and liberate all Mines together.
Mines Liberation in a cooperative version: you split the board between you.
The Red City Core tile, plus 1 Core tile without a City.
The Red City is friendly: each player places a Shield token on it.
When everything is revealed and liberated, each player plays one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the fourth Round.
Solved if all Mines are liberated. For a score: the Fame of the player furthest behind, plus 4 points per Countryside-tile Mine and 7 per Core-tile Mine.
Two blades, one City
Conquer the City, with each player having placed at least one Shield on it.
A level 8 City: too much for a single Hero in four Rounds. Prepare a cooperative assault.
The City is level 8. For a gentler game: level 5.
Cooperative assault reminder: from an adjacent space, a player proposes a split of the defenders; if the other accepts, each fights their share on their turn, then skips their next turn.
When the City is conquered, each player plays one last turn. Otherwise at the end of the fourth Round.
The Druids' Circle
Defeat together at least 3 red enemies summoned during the second Night.
Druid Nights as a team: the first Night is a warm-up, the second decides everything.
The Green City is friendly: each player places a Shield token on it.
Each player activates their own Glades and performs their own incantation.
When both players have performed their second-Night incantation, each plays one last turn. Otherwise at the end of that Night.
Solved if 3 summoned red enemies were defeated between you.
Volkare's Return, Blitz
Lost Legion
Conquer the City, then destroy Volkare's whole army there.
A race against General Volkare: he explores, finds the City and marches on it. Short version, in four Rounds.
5 Countryside tiles, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
1 Core tile without a City, and 1 Core tile with a City at the very bottom of the deck.
Conquer the City, then destroy Volkare's whole army there together.
The same race for two: conquer the City, then organise its cooperative defence.
6 Countryside tiles, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
Volkare's Return, Epic
The full version, in six Rounds, against a much larger army.
7 Countryside tiles, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
5 h and more
The great battle for two, over six Rounds.
8 Countryside tiles, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
2 Core tiles without a City, and 1 Core tile with a City at the very bottom of the deck.
Volkare's Quest
Destroy Volkare's whole army before he reaches the Portal.
Volkare marches straight for your Portal. Avoid him, grow stronger, then come back to stop him.
2 Core tiles with a City and 4 without, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
Destroy Volkare's whole army together before he reaches the Portal.
With two, you need to be next to Volkare at the right moment to attack him together.
9 Countryside tiles.
2 Core tiles with a City and 3 without, in addition to Volkare's Camp.
Blitz Conquest, with Volkare's Camp
Conquer the City and Volkare's Camp.
The expansions rulebook variant: one of the two Cities is replaced by Volkare's Camp. The Dummy player stays in play.
1 Core tile with a City, Volkare's Camp and 1 Core tile without a City, shuffled together.
The City and Volkare are level 3. For Volkare, the minimum level of his base is 4: 1 grey, 1 red, 2 green tokens.
Entering the Camp costs 2 Move points. Across a Wall: 1 more point, and the troops you face are Fortified.
Assaulting the Camp costs no Reputation. Volkare never moves; his tokens stay hidden until a player arrives on an adjacent space, by Day or Night.
Place a Shield on the Volkare token per red or white enemy defeated, and one per pair of grey or green enemies. If troops survive, you fall back and can come back, as for a City.
Camp conquered: from the Camp or an adjacent space, you recruit Village and Keep Units, with +1 Influence per Shield placed, and the Camp counts as a Keep for your Hand Limit.
When the City and the Camp are conquered, you play one last turn.
The conquered Camp counts as a City.
The Lost Relic
Shades of Tezla
Find the relic fragments in the two destroyed Cities.
Only two Rounds, but your Hero starts at Level 3. A Draconum guards each fragment.
Open board limited to 3 columns.
When all fragments are recovered, you play one last turn.
Mission: 5 points per fragment, 10 more if you have them all.
Find the relic fragments together in the three destroyed Cities.
The same hunt for two, with three ruined Cities to search in one Day and one Night.
Open board limited to 4 columns.
When all fragments are recovered, each player plays one last turn, not the Dummy.
Mission: 5 points per fragment, 5 more if each player found one, 10 more if you have them all.
The Forgotten Valley
Find the Forgotten Valley and defeat the High Priestess.
A valley hidden by magic: exploring costs three times as much, and the Elementalists lay ambushes.
5 Countryside tiles.
2 Core tiles with a City, the white and the green, and 1 without a City.
The green City is friendly: you and the Dummy place a Shield there, with no Lord.
The High Priestess is the Elementalists' Faction Leader, at level 4.
When the High Priestess is defeated, you play one last turn.
Mission: 20 points if the High Priestess is defeated, 30 per unused Round.
Find the Forgotten Valley and defeat the High Priestess together.
Two against a level 6 High Priestess: plan a cooperative assault.
Open board.
2 Core tiles with a City, the white and the green, and 2 without a City.
The green City is friendly: each player places a Shield there, with no Lord.
The High Priestess is the Elementalists' Faction Leader, at level 6.
When the High Priestess is defeated, each player plays one last turn, not the Dummy.
Mission: 20 points if the High Priestess is defeated, 20 if each player has a Shield on her token, 30 per unused Round.
The Realm of the Dead
Seal all the Graveyards and defeat the Necromancer.
The undead pursue you across the countryside. Liberate the Graveyards one by one, then march on the Necropolis.
5 Countryside tiles, exactly 2 of them with a Magical Glade.
2 Core tiles with a City, the blue and the green, and 1 without a City.
The Necromancer is the Dark Crusaders' Faction Leader, at level 4.
When all Graveyards are sealed and the Necromancer defeated, you play one last turn.
Mission: 5 points per sealed Graveyard, 10 for the Necromancer, 10 more if everything is done, 30 per unused Round.
Seal all the Graveyards and defeat the Necromancer together.
Three Graveyards to purify for two, and a level 6 Necromancer.
6 Countryside tiles, exactly 3 of them with a Magical Glade.
2 Core tiles with a City, the blue and the green, and 2 without a City.
The Necromancer is the Dark Crusaders' Faction Leader, at level 6.
When all Graveyards are sealed and the Necromancer defeated, each player plays one last turn, not the Dummy.
Mission: 5 points per sealed Graveyard, 10 for the Necromancer, 10 more if everything is done, 20 if each player has a Shield on his token, 30 per unused Round.
For life and death
Defeat the two Avatars of Tezla: the Leaders of both Factions.
The expansion's big scenario: the North for the Dark Crusaders, the South for the Elementalists, and you in the middle.
3 Core tiles with a City: the green, the red and another at random, friendly; 2 without a City.
Both Faction Leaders start at level 6.
When both Factions are defeated, you play one last turn.
Mission: 10 points per Avatar defeated, 15 more for both, 30 per unused Round.
Defeat the two Avatars of Tezla together.
Six Rounds for two against both Factions and their Leaders.
7 Countryside tiles, exactly 3 of them with a Magical Glade.
When both Factions are defeated, each player plays one last turn, not the Dummy.
Mission: 10 points per Avatar defeated, 15 more for both, 10 if each player has a Shield on at least one Leader, 10 more on both, 30 per unused Round.
